views.name: v_canteen_dishes_public
views.definition:
SELECT d.id,
    d.store_id,
    d.name,
    d.description,
    d.price,
    d.tag,
    d.sort,
    d.image
   FROM canteen_dishes d
     JOIN canteen_stores s ON s.id = d.store_id
  WHERE d.status = 'on'::text AND NOT d.sold_out AND s.status = 'open'::text;

views.name: v_canteen_reviews_public
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    store_id,
    canteen_mask_name(rater_name) AS rater_name,
    score,
    content,
    reply,
    replied_at,
    created_at
   FROM canteen_reviews
  ORDER BY created_at DESC;

views.name: v_canteen_store_ratings_public
views.definition:
SELECT store_id,
    count(*) AS rating_count,
    round(avg(score), 1) AS rating_avg
   FROM canteen_reviews
  GROUP BY store_id;

views.name: v_canteen_stores_public
views.definition:
SELECT s.id,
    s.name,
    s.emoji,
    s.description,
    s.tags,
    s.building,
    s.sort,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM canteen_dishes d
          WHERE d.store_id = s.id AND d.status = 'on'::text AND NOT d.sold_out) AS dish_count,
    s.notice,
    s.hours_text,
    COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0::bigint) AS rating_count,
    COALESCE(r.rating_avg, 0::numeric) AS rating_avg,
    s.hours_slots,
    s.force_closed,
    s.force_close_note,
    s.image
   FROM canteen_stores s
     LEFT JOIN v_canteen_store_ratings_public r ON r.store_id = s.id
  WHERE s.status = 'open'::text;

    pickup_place,

   FROM errand_orders
  WHERE status = 'open'::text

views.name: v_meals_items_public

    mask_creator_name(owner_name) AS owner_name,
    name,
    emoji,
    price,
    calorie,
    portion,
    serving_hours,
    description,
    images,
    tags,

   FROM meals_items

views.name: v_news_public
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    title,
    summary,
    body,
    cover,
    tag,
    source,
    is_top,
    mask_creator_name(creator_name) AS creator_name,
    status,
    published_at
   FROM news
  WHERE status = 'published'::text;

views.name: v_shop_goods_public
views.definition:
SELECT g.id,
    g.store_id,
    g.name,
    g.description,
    g.images,
    g.price,
    g.unit,
    g.category,
    g.tag,
    g.stock,
    g.sold_out,
    g.sort,
    g.promo_mode,
    g.tier_prices,
    gr.id AS group_id,
    gr.group_price,
    gr.min_members AS group_min_members,
    gr.deadline AS group_deadline,
    gr.member_count AS group_member_count,
    gr.member_qty AS group_member_qty
   FROM shop_goods g
     JOIN shop_stores s ON s.id = g.store_id
     LEFT JOIN shop_groups gr ON gr.goods_id = g.id AND gr.status = 'open'::text
  WHERE g.status = 'on'::text AND s.status <> 'suspended'::text;

views.name: v_shop_stores_public
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    name,
    emoji,
    logo_url,
    cover_url,
    description,
    notice,
    campus,
    building,
    room,
    contact,
    delivery_mode,
    hours_text,
    hours_slots,
    force_closed,
    force_close_note,
    status,
    sort,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM shop_goods g
          WHERE g.store_id = s.id AND g.status = 'on'::text AND NOT g.sold_out) AS goods_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM shop_groups gr
          WHERE gr.store_id = s.id AND gr.status = 'open'::text) AS group_count
   FROM shop_stores s
  WHERE status <> 'suspended'::text;

guard_sources.redacted_body:
DECLARE
  v_uid       text := auth.uid();
  v_limit     integer := LEAST(GREATEST(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 1), 100);
  v_before_id bigint := coalesce(p_before_id, 0);
  v_items     jsonb := '[literal]'::jsonb;
  v_page_cnt  integer := 0;
  v_total     integer := 0;
  v_unread    integer := 0;
  v_has_more  boolean := false;
  v_next      jsonb := NULL;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL OR public.current_is_anon() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '[literal]';
  END IF;

  -- 可见会话总数 + 我的未读总数：口径与列表严格一致（隐藏的会话不计入，
  -- 又因为新消息会清掉隐藏，不会留下「看不见的未读」长期挂账）
  SELECT count(*),
         coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN t.user_uid = v_uid THEN t.user_unread ELSE t.peer_unread END), 0)
    INTO v_total, v_unread
    FROM public.chat_threads t
   WHERE (t.user_uid = v_uid AND t.user_hidden_at IS NULL)
      OR (t.peer_uid = v_uid AND t.peer_hidden_at IS NULL);

  WITH box AS (
    SELECT t.*
      FROM public.chat_threads t
     WHERE t.user_uid = v_uid
       AND t.user_hidden_at IS NULL
       AND (p_before_at IS NULL OR (t.last_at, t.id) < (p_before_at, v_before_id))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.*
      FROM public.chat_threads t
     WHERE t.peer_uid = v_uid
       AND t.peer_hidden_at IS NULL
       AND (p_before_at IS NULL OR (t.last_at, t.id) < (p_before_at, v_before_id))
  ),
  page AS (
    SELECT b.*
      FROM box b
     ORDER BY b.last_at DESC, b.id DESC
     LIMIT v_limit + 1
  )
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(s.item ORDER BY s.last_at DESC, s.id DESC), '[literal]'::jsonb),
         (SELECT count(*) FROM page)
    INTO v_items, v_page_cnt
    FROM (
      SELECT b.last_at,
             b.id,
             jsonb_build_object(
               '[literal]',               b.id,
               '[literal]',       b.topic_type,
               '[literal]',         b.topic_id,
               '[literal]',      b.topic_title,
               '[literal]',         b.user_uid,
               '[literal]',        b.user_name,
               '[literal]',         b.peer_uid,
               '[literal]',        b.peer_name,
               '[literal]',        b.peer_role,
               '[literal]',     b.last_message,
               '[literal]',      b.last_sender,
               '[literal]',          b.last_at,
               '[literal]',       b.created_at,
               '[literal]',      b.user_unread,
               '[literal]',      b.peer_unread,
               '[literal]',        (b.user_uid = v_uid),
               '[literal]',        CASE WHEN b.user_uid = v_uid THEN b.user_unread ELSE b.peer_unread END,
               '[literal]',        CASE WHEN b.user_uid = v_uid THEN b.peer_uid ELSE b.user_uid END,
               '[literal]',       CASE WHEN b.user_uid = v_uid THEN b.peer_name ELSE b.user_name END,
               '[literal]',       CASE WHEN b.user_uid = v_uid THEN b.peer_role ELSE '[literal]' END,
               '[literal]', (b.last_sender = v_uid)
             ) AS item
        FROM page b
       ORDER BY b.last_at DESC, b.id DESC
       LIMIT v_limit
    ) s;

  v_has_more := v_page_cnt > v_limit;
  IF v_has_more THEN
    -- items 按 last_at DESC 排序，最后一条就是本页最旧的一条，作为下一页游标
    v_next := jsonb_build_object(
      '[literal]', v_items -> -1 -> '[literal]',
      '[literal]', v_items -> -1 -> '[literal]'
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    '[literal]',        v_items,
    '[literal]',        v_total,
    '[literal]', v_unread,
    '[literal]',     v_has_more,
    '[literal]',  v_next
  );
END;
